children: Attovia reported second-quarter 2026 results showing collaboration revenue of $0.5 million and a net loss of $20.7 million for the quarter. The company ended June 30, 2026 with $115.1 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities and expects IPO net proceeds to extend its cash runway into 2030. Attovia also reported preliminary Phase 1b clinical proof of concept for ATTO-1310 and outlined plans to initiate multiple Phase 2 and Phase 1 studies in 2027.
Revenue: Collaboration revenue of $0.5 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026.
Cash position: Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities of $115.1 million as of June 30, 2026.
R&D expenses: Research and development expense of $18.9 million for the quarter.
G&A expenses: General and administrative expense of $3.3 million for the quarter.
Net loss: Net loss of $20.7 million for the quarter; net loss per share attributable to common stockholders of $(4.88).

ATTO-1310: Preliminary Phase 1b results showed rapid, deep itch relief in chronic pruritus and high-itch atopic dermatitis and consistent lesion control in high-itch AD; complete Phase 1b data expected in Q4 2026.
Clinical plans: Global Phase 2 studies for chronic pruritus of unknown origin and high-itch AD planned to initiate in 1H 2027; FDA protocol submission for CPUO after incorporating agency feedback.
Pipeline progress: IND-enabling activities ongoing for ATTO-2306 (bispecific IL-31/IL-13) and ATTO-1091 (trispecific TL1A/IL-23p19/α4β7) with Phase 1 initiations planned in 1H 2027.
International development: Received IND clearance in China for a Phase 1b trial in cholestatic pruritus (PBC/PSC) via NMPA expedited review pathway.
Early-stage programs: Advanced ATTO-006 toward development candidate nomination by year-end 2026 for conditional “AND-gated” Trm survival blocking therapeutics.
